text: pid's one hmmsearch judge, on the first real run, moved no nail, mmseqs, diamond or hmmer run's recall by more than 0.006 against the run's own tool judging it. Exceptions: blast.prf 0.4988 under its own judge and 0.3971 under hmmer; last.seq 0.0380 against 0.0346. Their best decoys fall in repeat and coiled-coil families (TPH, Eap1, Vitellogenin_N) hmmer's bias filter does not call.
